{
  "name": "token-weather",
  "version": "0.4.0",
  "description": "A live dashboard of your context window and prompt cache above the prompt, in the analogy and language you pick",
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "author": {
    "name": "Patric Stahel"
  },
  "userConfig": {
    "analogy": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Analogy",
      "description": "How the band pictures the context fill: weather, moon, hearts, fuel, pot, tide, daytime or volcano",
      "default": "weather",
      "options": [
        "weather",
        "moon",
        "hearts",
        "fuel",
        "pot",
        "tide",
        "daytime",
        "volcano"
      ]
    },
    "cache": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Cache row",
      "description": "Show the prompt cache: full (its own row), compact (appended to the forecast) or off",
      "default": "full",
      "options": [
        "full",
        "compact",
        "off"
      ]
    },
    "cacheTtl": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Cache lifetime",
      "description": "How long the prompt cache lives after each request: 1h or 5m",
      "default": "1h",
      "options": [
        "1h",
        "5m"
      ]
    },
    "language": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Language",
      "description": "Language of the band: en, de, es, it or fr",
      "default": "en",
      "options": [
        "en",
        "de",
        "es",
        "it",
        "fr"
      ]
    }
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "repository": "https://github.com/pstahel/token-weather-claude-code-mod"
}
